title: Kissed Roasted Syrian Chorizo Tagine
description: A hearty and comforting Syrian dish featuring roasted chorizo, perfect for a sick day, and sugar-free friendly. This recipe combines tender chorizo with aromatic spices and steam to create a delicious and nourishing meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced chorizo with olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper until the chorizo is evenly coated.
Spread the chorizo mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the chorizo is roasting, heat the chicken broth in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the Dutch oven and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the Dutch oven and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Once the chorizo is done roasting, add it to the Dutch oven and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the tagine for 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together and the chorizo to steam in the aromatic broth.
